source.title: An unsolved problem in the theory of constructive order types

trace.notes: Resolved zbMATH document 3264936 via the zbMATH REST API to Alan G. Hamilton, "An unsolved problem in the theory of constructive order types", Journal of Symbolic Logic 33, pages 565-567, DOI 10.2307/2271363. The original zbMATH web page returned a Cloudflare challenge to local fetches.

Followed exact-work resolver links: DOI 10.2307/2271363 redirected to the Cambridge Core article; DBLP record journals/jsyml/Hamilton68 exposed both the DOI and Project Euclid URL http://projecteuclid.org/euclid.jsl/1183736509.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted with blocked_or_challenged fallback. Cambridge Core exposed only an article/issue extract and access-gated article/PDF routes; OpenAlex reported open_access.is_oa=false, oa_status=closed, oa_url=null, any_repository_has_fulltext=false, and no best_oa_location; Project Euclid returned an access-challenge HTML response. Exact-title searches recovered only Cambridge extracts, DBLP metadata, table-of-contents metadata, or unrelated citation contexts, not readable full text of the same article. Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/3264936.json and outputs/latest.json.
